purpose: Expand the frozen LOVE-EDEM marine analysis from exact-point-only coverage to the entire connected Atlantic marine domain while preserving the frozen point as the zero-distance anchor.

distance_influence_bands.meaning: direct/local footprint or station around frozen anchor
near-local survey context; may constrain bathymetry, water column and propagation
regional geology/acoustics and natural false-positive controls
Angola Basin, Congo margin, Walvis Ridge, Mid-Atlantic systems and comparable South Atlantic structures/surveys
South Atlantic-wide comparison including cross-basin surveys and historical acoustic/seismic cases
Atlantic-wide controls and anomaly cases retained for mechanism comparison, not local-geography claims

authoritative_public_sources.coverage: curated global multibeam swaths and cruise tracks
cruise-level raw and processed marine geophysics including South Atlantic datasets

known_current_examples.note: documented 3S section remains ~96 km from frozen latitude
PANGAEA raw EM1002 bathymetry and beam-time-series dataset exists for Walvis Ridge
distance does not discard a case; it changes only the allowed interpretation

interpretation_rules.exact_local: May contribute directly to frozen-anchor seafloor or water-column inference.
interpretation_rules.near_and_regional: May constrain propagation, geology and natural false positives but cannot be called direct target data.
interpretation_rules.basin_and_ocean_wide: May constrain mechanism prevalence, tectonic/acoustic context and anomaly recurrence; cannot establish a local physical connection without an independent bridge.
interpretation_rules.distance: Great-circle distance is metadata, not proof of influence or acoustic coupling.
interpretation_rules.direction: Azimuth/sector is descriptive unless a physical propagation, tectonic, current, ridge, fracture-zone or survey-path bridge is independently demonstrated.

search_objective: Build an Atlantic-wide ranked corpus around the frozen anchor rather than accepting only exact-point coverage.
